summary: Dominion Energy filed an 8-K disclosing litigation and demand letters related to its pending acquisition by NextEra Energy. Under the May 15, 2026 merger agreement, NextEra's subsidiaries will effect a two-step merger making Dominion a wholly owned subsidiary. A definitive proxy was filed July 28, 2026; a special shareholder meeting is set for September 3, 2026. Two New York lawsuits allege disclosure deficiencies in the proxy; Dominion believes the claims lack merit and no supplemental disclosures are needed. Watch for court rulings on injunctive relief or additional disclosure demands that could delay the closing.
